newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Onslow County, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Onslow County, N.C..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North
Carolina 27603-1385 until 11 o'clock a.m., North Carolina time,

such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of the above-captioned bonds of Onslow County, North Carolina, dated November 1, 1996, and maturing (subject to the right of prior redemption) in annual installments on May 1 in years and amounts, as follows:

School Bonds: $275,000, 1998 and 1999; $1,075,000 2000 to 2013, inclusive; and $1,100,000, 2014 to 2017, inclusive. Pubic Improvement Bonds:$50,000, 1998 and 1999; $275,000, 2000 to 2013, inclusive; and $50,000, 2014.

The approving opinion of The Sanford Law Firm PLLC, Raleigh, North Carolina, bond counsel the proposed form of which appears in the Official Statement related to the Bonds, will be furnished without cost to the purchaser. There will also be furnished the usual closing papers.

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919/733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form. The Public Improvement Bonds will be delivered on or about November 6, 1996, and the School Bonds will be delivered on or about November 7, 1996.
